The right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for:

Customized Goods: Items that are made to your personal specifications or are clearly tailored to your individual needs.

Sealed Goods: For products that are sealed for health protection or hygiene reasons, the right to return is voided if the seal is broken after delivery.
Mixed Goods: Items that have been inseparably mixed with other goods after delivery due to their nature.
Sealed Media: This applies to sealed audio or video recordings or computer software if the seal has been removed after you've received them.

Essentially, for our products, the most important point is that once the hygiene seal on a product is broken, it is no longer eligible for a return under the 14-day right of withdrawal policy.
